maria: CI smoke suite is red for hosted-integ on main — auth failures + toolcall schema errors
james: seeing 401s from token-service in the logs? got a snippet:
```
ERROR: auth: token validation failed: missing kid
POST /v1/generate 401
```
olivia: Also seeing streaming timeouts when tool-call starts, looks like header gets truncated
sam: @james can you share the last successful commit sha on those shards? we might bisect
james: last green was 1752b9c; failing since merge of PR #4287 (auth header middleware rewrite)
maria: can someone rerun the integ shard that touches hosted-api (shard 7)? ci-bot: @maria requested rerun for job hosted-integ/shard-7 — queued :white_check_mark:
devops-jen: I can triage if you grant me logs access; @olivia please upload remote logs to /tmp/hosted-integ-logs.tar
olivia: uploaded to s3://redwood-integ-logs/1753456789/hosted-shard7.tar.gz link: https://s3.redwood/api/1753456789
james: quick workaround: revert the middleware change in PR 4287 and run smoke locally, seems to fix 401s
maria: good. let's bisect on CI to confirm; if revert fixes, we'll hotfix and roll forward with a small auth patch
sam: fyi, adding a flaky test tag to streaming-toolcall.test to avoid blocking other merges — will follow up with a proper fixture
maria: ok, next steps: @devops-jen run bisect on hosted-integ across commits 1752b9c..HEAD; @james prepare rollback PR if bisect points to 4287
ci-bot: bisect job started: https://ci.redwood/jobs/bisect/1753456789 :hourglass:
olivia: ping me when bisect completes, i'll run a local reproducer with the exact header payloads
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
